ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota, including potential connections to state officials and healthcare providers.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to uncover the extent of the fraud and identify key players.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What is the extent of the fraud?
How did the scheme go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for healthcare services in Minnesota and potentially exposes a larger scheme of Medicaid fraud.

ideas.title: FBI Investigation into Alberto Carvalho
ideas.description: Investigate the FBI investigation into Los Angeles schools superintendent Alberto Carvalho, including potential financial improprieties and connections to other entities or individuals.
ideas.angle: Uncover the details of the investigation and potential wrongdoing by Carvalho.
questions: What are the specific allegations against Carvalho?
What are the potential implications for the Los Angeles Unified School District?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for education in Los Angeles and potentially exposes corruption or mismanagement within the school district.
